policy_denials.detail: cd <job>; ls evidence | head; ls evidence/records | head; ls work; ls evidence/records/jobs 2>/dev/null | head
cd <job>/work; wc -l crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs crates/athena-core/src/reading/*.rs crates/athena-core/tests/refusal_corpus.rs; git status --short | head

python3 -I -c "
import re
p='<job>/work/crates/athena-core/src/reading/coverage.rs'
s=open(p).read()
a=s.index('/// Phrases, lowercase, that ask the reader for a split')
b=s.index('/// Whether a sentence denies or questions a split')
new='''/// Words, lowercase, that let the reader do something when they come before a verb.
const SPLIT_MODALS: [&str; 7] = ["may", "can", \"could\", \"free to\", \"allowed to\", \"ok to\", \"okay to\"];

/// What a split is of, lowercase: the job, the request or the work.
const SPLIT_WHOLES: [&str; 6] = [
    \"this job\",
    \"the job\",
    \"this request\",
    \"the request\",
    \"this work\",
    \"the work\",
];

/// What a split makes, lowercase, so that `split it into jobs` names the pieces.
const SPLIT_PIECES: [&str; 7] = [
    \"it into jobs\",
    \"it into parts\",
    \"it into follow-ups\",
    \"it into separate jobs\",
    \"into separate jobs\",
    \"into follow-up jobs\",
    \"into follow-ups\",
];

'''
s=s[:a]+new+s[b:]
open(p,'w').write(s)
"
